description: Every Plinth error code with its exact English message. Error codes are part of the contract; messages may be shown to users. Changing either needs an ADR.

errors.message: The JSON text is not valid JSON.
The JSON value is nested deeper than 64 levels.
An object has the same member name twice.
A string contains a lone UTF-16 surrogate.
A number has a fraction or exponent; only integers are allowed.
An integer is outside -(2^53-1) to 2^53-1.
null is not allowed; omit the member instead.
The value is not a string, integer, boolean, array or plain object.
The bytes are not valid base64url, hex or DER.
Only Ed25519 (OKP) and P-256 (EC) public keys are supported.
The public key bytes are malformed or the point is not on the curve.
The kid does not match the key it is listed with.
The signed envelope does not have the required shape.
The spec version is unknown or newer than this verifier supports.
The envelope type is not on this verifier's allowlist.
The envelope has no signatures.
The signature algorithm is unknown.
The signature algorithm is not allowed for this envelope type.
The signing key is not in the trusted keys.
The same key signed the envelope twice.
The key type does not match the signature algorithm.
The signature does not verify.
Fewer valid signatures than the policy requires.
The trusted key has no WebAuthn relying-party settings.
The WebAuthn authenticator data or client data is malformed.
The WebAuthn client data type is not webauthn.get.
The WebAuthn challenge does not match the signed content.
The WebAuthn origin is not one of the registered origins.
The WebAuthn assertion was made in a cross-origin frame.
The WebAuthn relying-party ID hash does not match.
The authenticator did not report user presence.
The authenticator did not report user verification (fingerprint, face or PIN).
The audit export has no events.
An audit event does not have the required shape.
Actions starting with pk. are reserved for Plinth.
An event or checkpoint belongs to a different chain.
An event does not match its stored hash.
Event sequence numbers are missing or out of order.
An event does not link to the hash of the event before it.
A checkpoint does not have the required shape.
A checkpoint signature does not verify against the trusted keys.
A checkpoint head does not match the event hash at its sequence number.
A checkpoint covers events that are missing from the export.
Older events were removed but no checkpoint anchors the new start.
Older events were removed without a pk.audit.pruned event.
Warning: the newest events are intact but not yet covered by a checkpoint.
The approval request does not have the required shape.
The approval request or registry is for a different realm.
The action is not on this product's list of approvable actions.
The request was made against a newer approver registry than this verifier holds.
The thing about to be done is not the thing that was approved.
The request lifetime is longer than the registry allows.
The request was created more than 5 minutes in the future.
The approval has expired.
The approved window has not opened yet.
The approved window has closed.
This approval has already been used.
No signed decision was supplied.
A decision does not have the required shape.
The decision was signed for a different request.
The decision names a different approver than the key that signed it.
The signature algorithm does not match the approver's key profile.
This realm requires a device-bound key; a synced passkey was used.
An approver denied the request.
The decision time is outside the request lifetime.
The policy needs the requester's human identity, and it is missing.
The requester cannot approve their own request.
Not enough distinct approvers.
The approver registry does not have the required shape.
The first registry does not match the pinned genesis digest.
Registry versions must increase by exactly 1.
A registry change was not signed by an existing approver.
The registry is older than one this verifier has already seen.
A recovery code is 20 characters A-Z and 2-7, in four groups of five.
This recovery code is not in the registry.
This recovery code has already been used.
The YAML file has a syntax error.
The YAML file has a duplicate key.
The YAML file has more than one document.
YAML anchors and aliases are not allowed.
Explicit YAML tags are not allowed.
Quote this value: unquoted dates, yes/no/on/off, decimals, octal-like numbers and empty values are not allowed.
The rule-pack file does not match its JSON Schema.
This rule-pack kind has no body definition in this version.
Two rules have the same id and rev.
Two revisions of one rule have overlapping effective dates.
pair_with names a rule that is not in the pack.
The regular expression does not compile.
The regular expression uses a feature outside the portable dialect.
The regular expression has nested quantifiers (risk of catastrophic backtracking).
Every rule needs at least one match test and one no_match test.
A rule test did not give the expected result.
A rule-pack file does not match the digest in its manifest.
Only the Asia/Kolkata and UTC time zones are supported.
The text is longer than 1,000,000 characters.
Redaction needs an installation secret of at least 32 bytes.
The rule names a validator this version does not have.
